lines.text: You are about to yawn, and nobody fully knows why!
Yawns spread like a virus. About half of people catch one just from seeing it or hearing it!
Scientists first blamed empathy: you copy the yawn because you feel the other person.
It fits. Yawns spread faster between friends and family than between strangers.
A brain scan study saw a mirroring area light up when people watched a yawn.
But a study of over three hundred people found empathy barely mattered!
Is it just tiredness? Myth! Tiredness barely changed who caught a yawn, so the science is not settled.
So we know a yawn is contagious, and we still don't know why. Are you yawning right now?
